title: On the Quartic Invariant of Odd Degree Binary Forms
summary: We determine the squarefree part of the scalar factor that arises when the quartic invariant of the generic binary form $F$ of odd degree $2n+1$ is expressed as the discriminant of the unique quadratic covariant $(F,F)_{2n}$. This squarefree part is exactly $p$ when $n+2$ is a power of an odd prime $p$, and $1$ otherwise. Equivalently, for each prime $p$: $v_2(S(n))$ is always even, and for odd $p$, $v_p(S(n))$ is odd if and only if $n+2$ is a power of $p$.
